notes_for_review: Applies the Sparks write-and-refine loop to PINN-style PDE solvers, with a trained PINN as gradient baseline and an ablation of prompting, architecture editing and refinement. The striking machine-precision numbers on heat and advection come from the LLM writing the closed-form textbook solution into the architecture, so they measure recall of known solutions rather than weight programming per se. On nonlinear PDEs the generated networks have spiky derivatives and grid-sensitive residuals. Three runs, no code release stated, no random-weight control.
